title: Caresens Dual BT Meter not working with xDrip
symptom: When trying to make the Caresens Dual BT meter work with xDrip, you can pair the meter and xDrip starts chirping, but then it does the disconnect sound before any data comes through.
fix: Support for this meter was added in the June 9th Nightly, with notes provided in the wiki. Multiple reports of success on the latest nightlies.
evidence_quote: Ok support for this meter is added in the June 9th Nightly. See https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/CareSens-Dual-Glucose-Meter for some notes. Please let me know how it goes.
